T1059.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
T1059.description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries.
T1059.kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4688 // Process Creation
| where Process has_any ("powershell.exe", "cmd.exe", "bash", "sh")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc", "-e", "-nop", "-w hidden", "curl", "wget", "Invoke-WebRequest")
| project TimeGenerated, Account, Computer, Process, ProcessCommandLine, NewProcessName
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

T1110.name: Brute Force
T1110.description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts when passwords are unknown or when password hashes are obtained.
T1110.kql:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != 0 // Failed logins
| summarize FailedAttempts = count(), IPAddresses = make_set(IPAddress) by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName
| where FailedAttempts > 10 // Threshold for brute force
| project TimeGenerated = now(), UserPrincipalName, FailedAttempts, IPAddresses
| sort by FailedAttempts desc

T1078.name: Valid Accounts
T1078.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, or Defense Evasion.
T1078.kql:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == 0 // Successful login
| where IPAddress !has "10." and IPAddress !has "192.168." // External IP
| where UserPrincipalName has_any ("admin", "svc_", "backup") // High-value targets
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location, AppDisplayName, RiskState
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

T1566.name: Phishing
T1566.description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems.
T1566.kql:
OfficeActivity
| where Operation == "MessageTrace" or Operation == "EmailForward"
| where RecipientEmailAddress has_any ("external-domain.com") // Replace with your external domains
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

T1003.name: OS Credential Dumping
T1003.description: Adversaries may attempt to dump credentials to obtain account login and credential material.
T1003.kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4688
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mimikatz", "procdump", "lsass", "sekurlsa")
| project TimeGenerated, Account, Computer, ProcessCommandLine
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
